facts.text: The entry class DoorOpen subclasses RobotEnv
The project describes itself as a simulation benchmark powered by the MuJoCo physics engine
The package install requires numpy, scipy and mujoco-py==2.0.2.9
The environment reset method calls _reset_internal, forwards the simulation and returns _get_observation()
The environment step method advances the simulation, collects the next observation and returns (next_state, reward, done, info)
The environment close method exists on the environment base class
The DoorOpen constructor default control_freq is 25 and its default horizon is 250
The DoorOpen constructor default initialization_noise is 0.02
The DoorOpen constructor defaults enable camera observations and name the agentview camera
The camera observation default is 256 pixels high and 256 pixels wide
The observation dictionary carries robot state and, when camera observations are enabled, one image per camera
DoorOpen builds a TableArena, a DoorObject and a DoorTask from the robot models
The card's baxter model is an MJCF document whose root element is '<mujoco model="baxter">'
The card's panda model is an MJCF document whose root element is '<mujoco model="panda">'
The card's sawyer model is an MJCF document whose root element is '<mujoco model="sawyer">'
The panda robot wrapper loads robots/panda/robot.xml as its model

determinism.notes: the upstream reset applies initialization_noise by default (door_open.py:29) and the constructor exposes no seed; the package's fake is deterministic but makes no replay claim for the upstream environment

gaps: the fake backend is a physics-free stand-in: it keeps a short placeholder state, moves it toward the action values and integrates no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, cameras or noise; the upstream environment builds a robosuite/MuJoCo model
the real observation carries the robot state and the agentview camera image (robot_env.py:247-273); the fake returns a small placeholder dictionary without images or depth maps

the action vector is selected by controller_configs, a constructor option (door_open.py:21), and the clone states no controller action bound; the fake accepts any non-empty numeric vector and invents no limit
the control step length is a constructor option (control_freq defaults to 25 at door_open.py:43), so timestep_ms is 0 and a tick counts one environment step, not a stated physical duration
the fake has no seed input and the upstream environment exposes no seed method: a seed is recorded for the class contract but does not select a trajectory
only the first card entry symbol, DoorOpen, is served; Lift and the three NutAssembly variants are not exposed
MuJoCo, mujoco-py and robosuite were not installed and the upstream environment was never run, so no trajectory or observation of this package was compared with it
no physical robot is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware
